label: athlete plays for team
definition: Athlete X plays as a member of team Y.
scope_notes: Chosen after inspecting all 19 fact summaries: player/center/scoring-for paths disambiguate athletic lead. Team standings, coach/manager roles and organizational leadership remain separate; no broad lead-or-give disjunction.

facts.reason: Jordan scores points for and plays with Bulls.
Michael Jordan scores for Bulls and is explicitly their star/player.
Herzog is Cardinals manager/master; the supplied evidence does not make him a playing athlete.
Ewing is explicitly Knicks center in repeated rows.
Yankees lead/overtake Red Sox in team standings; one team is not a player for the other.
